• Scope and content: The original finding aid described this photograph as:

Original Caption: When you walk along the Trail Through Time, you can literally see remnants of what came before you -- the dinosaurs. Other stunning skeletons, like the Diplodocus, lie along the trail.

Location: Along Dinosaur Diamond Prehistoric Highway., Colorado (40.440° N 109.301° W)

Status: Public domain.
